items.name: NIC: Disable Adapter Power Management (all physical adapters)
items.description: Uses NetAdapter cmdlets to disable adapter-level power management on physical NICs.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ Disable-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $n.Name -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name * | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

items.name: NIC: Disable Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) where present
items.description: Enumerates advanced properties and disables EEE only on adapters that expose the property.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ $props=Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $eee=$props | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match "Energy Efficient Ethernet|EEE" -or $_.RegistryKeyword -match "EEE" }; foreach($p in $eee){ Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Output "EEE property pass complete."

items.name: NIC: Disable Green Ethernet / Power Saving labels (if present)
items.description: Disables common vendor power-saving labels dynamically: Green Ethernet, Ultra Low Power, Reduce Speed On Power Down, Idle Power Saving.

steps.command: $patterns='Green Ethernet','Ultra Low Power','Reduce Speed On Power Down','Idle Power Saving','Auto Disable Gigabit'; $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ $props=Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($p in $props){ if($patterns | Where-Object { $p.DisplayName -like ('*'+$_+'*') -or $p.RegistryKeyword -like ('*'+$_.Replace(' ','')+'*') }){ try{ Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} } } }; Write-Output 'Green/power-saving pass complete.'

items.name: NIC: Inventory all advanced power-related properties
items.description: Exports all adapter advanced properties to logs so only real, adapter-supported controls are shown/tuned.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $dir=Join-Path $PWD 'logs'; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }; $out=Join-Path $dir ('nic-advanced-properties-'+$ts+'.txt'); Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { '=== ' + $_.Name + ' ===' | Out-File -Encoding utf8 -Append $out; Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $_.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object DisplayName | Format-Table DisplayName,DisplayValue,RegistryKeyword,RegistryValue -AutoSize | Out-String | Out-File -Encoding utf8 -Append $out }; Write-Output ('Saved: ' + $out)
